subject.title: refactor(channels): remove v2026.7.2-gated compat (flat streaming keys, group intro hint)

question: Should v2026.7.2 intentionally remove the external channel streaming fallbacks and `resolveGroupIntroHint` adapter before the normal tagged deprecation window is independently verified?
rationale: This is an intentional compatibility and plugin-contract change rather than a mechanical defect; the PR body asserts early approval, but the supplied visible discussion does not provide the decision or its upgrade rationale.

options.title: Keep one tagged deprecation window
options.body: Retain the fallback readers and deprecated adapter until a release containing clear warnings has shipped, then remove them in the scheduled follow-up.

options.title: Approve early breaking removal
options.body: Explicitly accept the v2026.7.2 compatibility break after confirming doctor migrates affected stored configurations and external plugin owners have an upgrade path.

recommendation.title: Keep one tagged deprecation window
recommendation.body: Retain the fallback readers and deprecated adapter until a release containing clear warnings has shipped, then remove them in the scheduled follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this person directly to both the current and earlier compatibility-removal plans.
